about: Vetted third-party skills install_skill.sh may install, each pinned to a commit that was at least two weeks old when vetted. Anthropic's github.com/anthropics/skills needs no entry. Only a human adds entries here: check the license, read every file at the pinned ref, and make sure the skill ships no hooks, binaries, downloads or remote instructions.

emil-design-eng.why: UI polish and component craft; markdown only.

review-animations.why: Reviews existing motion: purpose, duration, easing, reduced motion; markdown only.

baseline-ui.why: Baseline UI rules (spacing, type, states) that fit a consistency audit; markdown only.

improve-ui.why: Structured critique of an existing screen; markdown plus reference files.

fixing-accessibility.why: Fix patterns for common WCAG failures; backs the a11y layer; markdown only.

ui-ux-pro-max.why: Searchable UX guidelines, palettes and stack-specific rules; ships stdlib-only Python search scripts.

not_allowlisted.impeccable (pbakaus/impeccable): launcher runs and downloads a native binary, and installs hooks that run on every edit; install only with the user's explicit consent
not_allowlisted.web-design-guidelines (vercel-labs/agent: fetches its rules from a remote URL on every run (remote instructions, rule S6); no license detected
not_allowlisted.taste-skill (Leonxlnx/taste-skill): restyling skill for new landing pages, not an audit; very new repository
